## Shared scenes

> At Diana's party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts the dare, loses her balance, and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the doctor puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on several weeks of bed rest.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P23](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly grows fond of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities and Miss Stacy's project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warm encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P16](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0016)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to support Anne's joining the class, which delights [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The Queen's class is formed, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels saddened by Diana's absence and finds herself in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while privately regretting her past grudge against him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)_

> School finishes for the term, and Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs away her books to enjoy her summer vacation. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), noting Matthew's health issues and commending [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on how well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown up.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a relaxing summer outdoors following a doctor's advice before returning to her studies under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). As the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations approach, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and matured both physically and mentally.
>
